decides: 개별 이슈의 교훈이 조직 차원에서 재사용 가능한 형태로 축적·색인되는가
produces: curated pattern-library entry, cross-issue index, supersession note (if replacing an older pattern)

deliverable_form.method: APQC KM maturity-level-scoped artifact (process doc, lessons-learned entry, or community-of-practice note)
deliverable_form.source: APQC KM-CAT and maturity levels; apqc.org/resource-library

feedback_methodology.method: Externalization check: does the artifact convert a named person's tacit know-how into a reusable explicit form

judgment_methodology.method: SECI model (Socialization-Externalization-Combination-Internalization) to judge whether tacit knowledge has actually been captured

planning_methodology.method: ISO 30401 knowledge-management-system planning cycle (context, leadership, planning, support)

quality_bar.verification_method: automated check that `capture_point` equals `at-resolution`, matching the spec's own `recomputation` rule that a retroactive capture is a refusal state
quality_bar.verified_source: Consortium for Service Innovation, 'KCS v6 Practices Guide' — https://www.thekcsacademy.net/kcs/ (primary source; "capture in the workflow" — capturing knowledge at the moment of resolution rather than after — is KCS's own first stated core principle).

quality_bar.verification_method: human-review-checklist: does `article_content` describe the specific problem-and-resolution actually encountered, rather than a generic templated restatement with the specifics stripped out?
quality_bar.verified_source: Consortium for Service Innovation, KCS 'Solve loop' — https://www.thekcsacademy.net/kcs/ (primary source; the Solve loop's Capture step is defined as capturing the issue in the searcher's own words/context, distinct from a boilerplate template).

quality_bar.verification_method: automated check that `reuse_status` is `reused` or `flagged-for-review` only when a prior matching `article_id` is cited, and `new` only when no matching article was found
quality_bar.verified_source: Consortium for Service Innovation, KCS 'Solve loop' — https://www.thekcsacademy.net/kcs/ (primary source; "search first" — checking for an existing article before creating a new one — is a KCS Solve-loop step this criterion operationalizes).

quality_bar.verification_method: human-review-checklist: does the article convert a named person's tacit know-how into a reusable explicit form (the spec's own `feedback_methodology`), rather than a raw activity log?
quality_bar.verified_source: Nonaka & Takeuchi, The Knowledge-Creating Company (Oxford University Press, 1995) (primary source; the SECI model's Externalization mode is precisely tacit-to-explicit conversion, matching the spec's own cited judgment_methodology).

quality_bar.verification_method: gates/quality_bar.py:human_comprehensibility_verdict against the role's own docs/issue-<n>/reports/<role>.md record text (gates/human_comprehensibility.py tier-1 structural prose rules: lead paragraph present, citation trailing placement, section size bound, no raw dump, enumeration cap); a record with no human-facing prose section anywhere is exempt (bar-met) -- issue #1623.

recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)
recomputation.rule: capture_point must equal at-resolution — KCS's own capture-at-point-of-resolution invariant (mirrors issue-515 invariant 1); a retroactive capture is a refusal state, not a silent pass.

reference_resolution.rule: article_id must resolve to an actual KB article file — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

review_methodology.method: ISO 30401 conformance check against the standard's knowledge-development and knowledge-sharing clauses

use_when.board_condition: an issue reaches resolution AND no knowledge-management record exists yet for that resolution

use_when: 여러 이슈의 회고가 쌓여 지식 큐레이션이 필요할 때
